changelog:
⚡ What's New & Fixed in v1.8.5:

• 🎬 Gemini 3.1+ Live API Video Schema Fix: Fixed critical error (code 1007) by replacing deprecated media_chunks with official realtime_input.video schema, restoring seamless bidirectional voice during screen share.

• 📱 Android 14+ Entire Screen Capture: Configured MediaProjectionConfig.createConfigForDefaultDisplay() so Jarvis sees the full mobile screen across all apps (Instagram, YouTube, etc.) instead of locking to single app.

• 🚀 Persistent App State: Prevented auto-minimizing on screen share start so the app remains open and responsive.

• ⚡ Zero-Starvation 1 FPS Capture Engine: Expanded ImageReader buffer to 4 with throttled 2 FPS frame extraction for zero latency and zero GPU starvation.
